summary: Barclays PLC furnished a Form 6-K carrying a London Stock Exchange PDMR disclosure: Group Chief Risk Officer Taalib Shaah acquired 9,512 ordinary shares of 25 pence nominal value on 2026-11-02 at 1.17 per share, following exercise of an option under the Barclays Group SAYE Share Option Scheme, executed outside a trading venue. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or consideration applies. This is a routine UK MAR Article 19 managerial-transaction notification, the US equivalent of a Form 4 ownership report, with no structural or regulatory-clock implications; no deal or special-situation angle to watch.
